/* Attd07Mapper.selectMonthlyOvertimeList */ WITH RECURSIVE /* 1. 부서 트리 — 시작 노드부터 하위까지 */ node_tree AS ( SELECT N.CMPNY_CD , N.SITE_CD , N.NODE_CD FROM TB_SITE_NODE N WHERE N.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND N.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND N.NODE_CD = #{nodeCd}
UNION ALL
SELECT C.CMPNY_CD , C.SITE_CD , C.NODE_CD FROM TB_SITE_NODE C INNER JOIN node_tree P ON C.CMPNY_CD = P.CMPNY_CD AND C.SITE_CD = P.SITE_CD AND C.PARENT_NODE_CD = P.NODE_CD
)
SELECT O.OT_ID AS otId , O.ATTD_ID AS attdId , O.REQ_ID AS reqId
, O.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , O.SITE_CD AS siteCd , O.USER_CD AS userCd , O.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , O.NODE_CD AS nodeCd
, O.PLAN_START_DATE AS planStartDate , O.PLAN_START_TIME AS planStartTime , O.PLAN_END_DATE AS planEndDate , O.PLAN_END_TIME AS planEndTime
, O.ACTUAL_START_DATE AS actualStartDate , O.ACTUAL_START_TIME AS actualStartTime , O.ACTUAL_START_METHOD AS actualStartMethod , O.ACTUAL_END_DATE AS actualEndDate , O.ACTUAL_END_TIME AS actualEndTime , O.ACTUAL_END_METHOD AS actualEndMethod
, O.WORK_MINUTES AS workMinutes , O.BREAK_MINUTES AS breakMinutes
, O.OT_STATUS AS otStatus
, O.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate FROM TB_USER_OVERTIME_MGMT O INNER JOIN node_tree NT ON O.CMPNY_CD = NT.CMPNY_CD AND O.SITE_CD = NT.SITE_CD AND O.NODE_CD = NT.NODE_CD WHERE O.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND O.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND O.WORK_YMD LIKE CONCAT(REPLACE(#{workYm}, '-', ''), '%') AND O.DEL_YN = 'N' AND O.OT_STATUS <> 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY O.USER_CD, O.WORK_YMD, O.ACTUAL_START_DATE, O.ACTUAL_START_TIME

/* Attd07Mapper.selectDailyAttdDetailHistory */
SELECT B.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , B.HIST_ID AS histId , B.ATTD_ID AS attdId , B.HIST_TYPE AS histType , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( B.CMPNY_CD , 'SYST_VAL' , B.HIST_TYPE , 'SYS032' ) AS histTypeNm , A.WORK_SEQ AS workSeq , B.BEF_CHECK_IN_DATE AS befCheckInDate , B.BEF_CHECK_IN_TIME AS befCheckInTime , B.BEF_CHECK_OUT_DATE AS befCheckOutDate , B.BEF_CHECK_OUT_TIME AS befCheckOutTime
, B.AFT_CHECK_IN_DATE AS aftCheckInDate , B.AFT_CHECK_IN_TIME AS aftCheckInTime , B.AFT_CHECK_OUT_DATE AS aftCheckOutDate , B.AFT_CHECK_OUT_TIME AS aftCheckOutTime
, B.PROCESS_REASON AS processReason , B.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( B.CMPNY_CD , 'USER_NM' , B.INSERT_NO , null ) AS insertNm , B.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate
, NULL AS befSchedFstStrTime , NULL AS befSchedFstEndTime , NULL AS befSchedSecStrTime , NULL AS befSchedSecEndTime , NULL AS aftSchedFstStrTime , NULL AS aftSchedFstEndTime , NULL AS aftSchedSecStrTime , NULL AS aftSchedSecEndTime
, NULL AS reqType , CASE WHEN B.HIST_TYPE IN ('01', '07', '08', '09') THEN ( SELECT R.REQ_REASON FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND R.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD AND R.WORK_YMD = B.WORK_YMD AND R.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND R.PROCESS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND R.REQ_TYPE IN ( CASE WHEN B.HIST_TYPE IN ('01', '07') THEN '01' ELSE '03' END , CASE WHEN B.HIST_TYPE IN ('01', '07') THEN '02' ELSE '04' END ) AND R.REQ_STATUS = CASE WHEN B.HIST_TYPE IN ('01', '08') THEN '02' ELSE '03' END AND ( R.TARGET_ID = B.ATTD_ID OR ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, R.PROCESS_DATE, B.INSERT_DATE)) <= 60 ) ORDER BY (R.TARGET_ID = B.ATTD_ID) DESC , ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, R.PROCESS_DATE, B.INSERT_DATE)) ASC LIMIT 1 ) ELSE NULL END AS reqReason
, NULL AS befPreFixedOtStrTime , NULL AS befPreFixedOtEndTime , NULL AS befFixedOtStrTime , NULL AS befFixedOtEndTime , NULL AS aftPreFixedOtStrTime , NULL AS aftPreFixedOtEndTime , NULL AS aftFixedOtStrTime , NULL AS aftFixedOtEndTime FROM TB_USER_ATTD_HIST B LEFT JOIN TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT A ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.ATTD_ID = B.ATTD_ID ) WHERE B.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND B.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND B.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND ( A.USER_CD = #{userCd} OR ( A.ATTD_ID IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND R.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD AND R.WORK_YMD = B.WORK_YMD AND R.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND R.REQ_TYPE = '01' AND R.REQ_STATUS = '03' ) ) ) ORDER BY B.INSERT_DATE DESC

/* Attd07Mapper.selectMonthlyAttdReq */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.REQ_ID AS reqId , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , A.USER_CD AS userCd , A.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( A.CMPNY_CD , 'SYST_VAL' , A.REQ_TYPE , 'SYS032' ) AS reqTypeNm , A.REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( A.CMPNY_CD , 'SYST_VAL' , A.REQ_STATUS , 'SYS033' ) AS reqStatusNm , A.WORK_SEQ AS workSeq , A.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , A.START_DATE AS startDate , A.START_TIME AS startTime , A.END_DATE AS endDate , A.END_TIME AS endTime , A.REQ_REASON AS reqReason , A.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , ( SELECT AP.APPROVAL_STEP FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ_APPROVAL AP WHERE AP.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AP.REQ_ID = A.REQ_ID AND AP.APPROVER_USER_CD = #{gvUserCd} AND AP.APPROVAL_STATUS = '01' LIMIT 1 ) AS approvalStep
, A.SCH_CD AS schCd
, TS.SCH_TYPE AS tgtSchType , TS.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS tgtFstStrTime , TS.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS tgtFstEndTime , TS.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS tgtSecStrTime , TS.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS tgtSecEndTime , CS.SCH_TYPE AS curSchType , CS.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS curFstStrTime , CS.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS curFstEndTime , CS.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS curSecStrTime , CS.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS curSecEndTime
, A.LEAVE_DAYS AS leaveDays , U.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( A.CMPNY_CD , 'SYST_VAL' , U.USE_UNIT_TYPE , 'SYS025' ) AS unitNm
, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(BU.LEAVE_DAYS), 0) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE BU JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT BG ON BG.CMPNY_CD = BU.CMPNY_CD AND BG.GRANT_ID = BU.GRANT_ID AND BG.DEL_YN = 'N' AND BG.GRANT_REASON LIKE '[가불] %' WHERE BU.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND BU.REQ_ID = A.REQ_ID AND BU.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND BU.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS borrowDays
, TS.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS tgtPreFixedOtStrTime , TS.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS tgtPreFixedOtEndTime , TS.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS tgtFixedOtStrTime , TS.FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS tgtFixedOtEndTime , CS.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS curPreFixedOtStrTime , CS.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS curPreFixedOtEndTime , CS.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS curFixedOtStrTime , CS.FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS curFixedOtEndTime FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ A
LEFT JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT TS ON TS.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND TS.SITE_CD = A.SITE_CD AND TS.SCH_CD = A.SCH_CD
LEFT JOIN TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP ON WP.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND WP.SITE_CD = A.SITE_CD AND WP.USER_CD = A.USER_CD AND WP.WORK_YMD = A.WORK_YMD LEFT JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT CS ON CS.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND CS.SITE_CD = A.SITE_CD AND CS.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD
LEFT JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U ON U.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( (A.REQ_TYPE = '05' AND U.REQ_ID = A.REQ_ID AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.LEAVE_ID = ( SELECT MIN(X.LEAVE_ID) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE X WHERE X.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND X.REQ_ID = A.REQ_ID AND X.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND X.DEL_YN = 'N' )) OR (A.REQ_TYPE = '06' AND U.LEAVE_ID = A.TARGET_ID) ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND A.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND A.REQ_STATUS = '01'

/* Attd07Mapper.selectDailyConfirmedLeave */
SELECT U.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , LT.LEAVE_NM AS leaveNm , U.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(U.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', U.USE_UNIT_TYPE, 'SYS025') AS unitNm , U.START_TIME AS startTime , U.END_TIME AS endTime
, IFNULL(R.LEAVE_DAYS , CASE WHEN U.REQ_ID IS NULL THEN U.LEAVE_DAYS ELSE ( SELECT SUM(X.LEAVE_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE X WHERE X.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND X.REQ_ID = U.REQ_ID AND X.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND X.DEL_YN = 'N' ) END ) AS leaveDays FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U LEFT JOIN TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT LT ON LT.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND LT.LEAVE_CD = U.LEAVE_CD
LEFT JOIN TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R ON R.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND R.REQ_ID = U.REQ_ID WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND U.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND U.START_DATE = #{workYmd} AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( U.REQ_ID IS NULL OR R.REQ_STATUS != '01' )
AND ( U.REQ_ID IS NULL OR U.LEAVE_ID = ( SELECT MIN(X.LEAVE_ID) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE X WHERE X.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND X.REQ_ID = U.REQ_ID AND X.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND X.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ) ORDER BY U.START_TIME, U.LEAVE_ID

/* Attd07Mapper.selectDailyLeaveApprovalHistory */
SELECT AP.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , NULL AS histId , NULL AS attdId , AP.APPROVAL_STATUS AS histType , CONCAT( FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(AP.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', R.REQ_TYPE, 'SYS032') , ' ' , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(AP.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', AP.APPROVAL_STATUS, 'SYS044') ) AS histTypeNm , NULL AS workSeq , NULL AS befCheckInDate , NULL AS befCheckInTime , NULL AS befCheckOutDate , NULL AS befCheckOutTime , NULL AS aftCheckInDate , NULL AS aftCheckInTime , NULL AS aftCheckOutDate , NULL AS aftCheckOutTime , AP.APPROVAL_COMMENT AS processReason , AP.APPROVER_USER_CD AS insertNo , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(AP.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', AP.APPROVER_USER_CD, null) AS insertNm , AP.APPROVAL_DATE AS insertDate
, NULL AS befSchedFstStrTime , NULL AS befSchedFstEndTime , NULL AS befSchedSecStrTime , NULL AS befSchedSecEndTime , NULL AS aftSchedFstStrTime , NULL AS aftSchedFstEndTime , NULL AS aftSchedSecStrTime , NULL AS aftSchedSecEndTime
, NULL AS reqType , R.REQ_REASON AS reqReason
, NULL AS befPreFixedOtStrTime , NULL AS befPreFixedOtEndTime , NULL AS befFixedOtStrTime , NULL AS befFixedOtEndTime , NULL AS aftPreFixedOtStrTime , NULL AS aftPreFixedOtEndTime , NULL AS aftFixedOtStrTime , NULL AS aftFixedOtEndTime FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ_APPROVAL AP JOIN TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R ON R.CMPNY_CD = AP.CMPNY_CD AND R.REQ_ID = AP.REQ_ID WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND R.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND R.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND R.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND R.REQ_TYPE IN ('05','06') AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AP.APPROVAL_STATUS IN ('02','03') AND AP.APPROVAL_DATE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY AP.APPROVAL_DATE DESC

/* Attd07Mapper.selectDailySchedModifyHistory - PRAFTA-APP-007-WEB-6 + D15 */
SELECT R.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , NULL AS histId , NULL AS attdId , R.REQ_STATUS AS histType , CONCAT( FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', R.REQ_TYPE, 'SYS032') , ' ' , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', R.REQ_STATUS, 'SYS033') ) AS histTypeNm , NULL AS workSeq , NULL AS befCheckInDate , NULL AS befCheckInTime , NULL AS befCheckOutDate , NULL AS befCheckOutTime , NULL AS aftCheckInDate , NULL AS aftCheckInTime , NULL AS aftCheckOutDate , NULL AS aftCheckOutTime
, CASE WHEN R.REQ_STATUS = '02' THEN NULL ELSE R.PROCESS_COMMENT END AS processReason , R.PROCESS_USER_CD AS insertNo , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', R.PROCESS_USER_CD, null) AS insertNm , R.PROCESS_DATE AS insertDate
, COALESCE(BS.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, BWP.FST_SCH_STR_TIME) AS befSchedFstStrTime , COALESCE(BS.FST_SCH_END_TIME, BWP.FST_SCH_END_TIME) AS befSchedFstEndTime , COALESCE(BS.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, BWP.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME) AS befSchedSecStrTime , COALESCE(BS.SEC_SCH_END_TIME, BWP.SEC_SCH_END_TIME) AS befSchedSecEndTime , AS_.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS aftSchedFstStrTime , AS_.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS aftSchedFstEndTime , AS_.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS aftSchedSecStrTime , AS_.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS aftSchedSecEndTime
, R.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , R.REQ_REASON AS reqReason
, COALESCE(BS.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME, BWP.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME) AS befPreFixedOtStrTime , COALESCE(BS.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME, BWP.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME) AS befPreFixedOtEndTime , COALESCE(BS.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME, BWP.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME) AS befFixedOtStrTime , COALESCE(BS.FIXED_OT_END_TIME, BWP.FIXED_OT_END_TIME) AS befFixedOtEndTime , AS_.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS aftPreFixedOtStrTime , AS_.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS aftPreFixedOtEndTime , AS_.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS aftFixedOtStrTime , AS_.FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS aftFixedOtEndTime FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R
LEFT JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT AS_ ON AS_.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND AS_.SITE_CD = R.SITE_CD AND AS_.SCH_CD = R.SCH_CD
LEFT JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT BS ON BS.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND BS.SITE_CD = R.SITE_CD AND R.REQ_STATUS = '02' AND R.PROCESS_COMMENT LIKE 'SCHED_MODIFY_APPROVED:OLD=%' AND BS.SCH_CD = SUBSTRING_INDEX(R.PROCESS_COMMENT, 'OLD=', -1)
LEFT JOIN TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP ON WP.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND WP.SITE_CD = R.SITE_CD AND WP.USER_CD = R.USER_CD AND WP.WORK_YMD = R.WORK_YMD AND R.REQ_STATUS = '03' LEFT JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT BWP ON BWP.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND BWP.SITE_CD = R.SITE_CD AND BWP.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND R.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND R.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND R.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND R.REQ_TYPE = '10' AND R.REQ_STATUS IN ('02','03') AND R.PROCESS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY R.PROCESS_DATE DESC

, O.WORK_MINUTES AS workMinutes , O.BREAK_MINUTES AS breakMinutes

/* Attd07Mapper.selectUserAttdReqByReqId */ SELECT R.REQ_ID AS reqId , R.TARGET_ID AS targetId , R.USER_CD AS userCd , R.SITE_CD AS siteCd , R.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , R.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , R.WORK_SEQ AS workSeq , R.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , R.REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus , R.DEL_YN AS delYn , R.SCH_CD AS schCd FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND R.REQ_ID = #{reqId} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N'
